subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should newly created `current` and `session:*` cron jobs persist `{ mode: "announce" }`, or should their delivery remain runtime-derived through the persistent-session path?
rationale: This changes a stored default and upgrade semantics for persistent sessions; source consistency alone cannot establish that this persistence policy is intended.

options.title: Keep isolated-only persistence
options.body: Retain current creation semantics and test that `current` and `session:*` leave delivery unset so runtime routing remains canonical.

options.title: Approve persistent announce
options.body: Accept the new stored default only with explicit cron-owner approval plus fresh-install, upgrade, and no-duplicate delivery proof.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or defer the PR if no owner wants to establish a new persisted delivery contract for persistent-session jobs.

recommendation.title: Keep isolated-only persistence
recommendation.body: Retain current creation semantics and test that `current` and `session:*` leave delivery unset so runtime routing remains canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-contract provenance is the merged persistent-session restoration work they authored and carried.
